name: linear
description: Linear: read issues, teams, projects and a team backlog, and add a comment to an issue (the only change it can make). Needs a personal API key.

tools.name: linear_check_connection
tools.description: Check the Linear connection (API key) and show who the key belongs to and the workspace.

tools.name: linear_list_teams
tools.description: List the Linear teams (key, name) the key can see. Read only.

tools.name: linear_list_projects
tools.description: List projects with state, progress and target date, optionally of one team. Read only.

tools.name: linear_search_issues
tools.description: Search issues by words in the title or description, newest change first. Read only.

tools.name: linear_read_backlog
tools.description: Read the open issues of a team for a requirements document. Read only.

tools.name: linear_get_issue
tools.description: Read one issue: description, state, labels, cycle and the last comments. Read only.

tools.name: linear_add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an issue (this changes Linear). Ask the person before using it.

linear_api_key.title: Personal API key
linear_api_key.description: Linear, Settings, Account, Security and access, Personal API keys, New key. Choose Read and, for comments, Create comments (no more). Stored as a secret.
